chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The righteous son is an aromatic flower from the flowers of Paradise.'

key_terms.رَيْحَانَةٌ: An aromatic flower or pleasant plant

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of a righteous child in Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) conveys the Prophet’s description of a righteous child as a 'rihan' (aromatic flower) of Paradise, emphasizing the enduring spiritual comfort and intercessory potential of pious offspring. In Shia tradition, this metaphor underscores the child's role as a source of serenity and a tangible blessing that reflects divine mercy upon the parents.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The righteous son is an aromatic flower from the flowers of the Paradise’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
A virtuous son is a sweet smelling flower from the flowers of paradise.’”
